notes.title: 2024/10/15 Update Log
notes.content:
Dear investigator, thank you for playing our game!
This time we participated in the Steam Next Fest, we felt the love from different regions' friends ~ In order to provide more and better services, we have made the following adjustments based on your feedback.

[h2]Updated on October 15[/h2]
1.New resolution.
2.New button: quit game. 
3. New multi-language version: Traditional Chinese.
4. Fix the issue that during the newbie guide, editing the initial deck in the deck editor prompts error, resulting in the deck not being saved.
5. Repair the problem of empty bubbles in Shea.

If you have any questions, you can contact us through the following way~
[h3] Email：tftcs@bibbuyer.com
QQ: 3812290556
QQ群：756729930[/h3]

notes.title: The demo goes live on The Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235605/1b9bb86183e0312530681a9a47945d34584fd6ba.jpg[/img]

Dear Investigators, First time meeting~ We are a small team, we have completed the demo version of The Fireseed Treaty and are participating in the Steam Next Fest, and we are looking forward to colliding the sparks of gaming fun with all of you! We hope that those who are interested can head over to our Steam store page to add a wishlist, thank you~

During the Steam Next Fest, we will be sending out game resources via email every day, one new hero per day as well as other resources, each hero has unique skills and we hope you can explore different genres~! 
If you have any questions, you can email to 
[h2][tftcs@bibbuyer.com][/h2]
we will be happy to help you out~
